title: Toy and process of use
abstract: A helical spring toy with rectangular cross-section that transfers turns from one end to another when bent into semi-circular form. When placed on an inclined plane or steps, the toy walks end-over-end downhill using gravity and initial force, without continuous external input.
gist: The Slinky: a helical spring with a flat rectangular wire cross-section and a low natural frequency, tuned so that coils transfer from one end to the other and the spring walks down stairs on its own.
